title: Canonical affine edge by inversion of the unique reverse comparison
statement: For A,B,φ,i as in [lem-pc-affine-derived-pushforward-sheaf-edge-descent], define affineDerivedPushforwardSheafReverseIso to be the unique natural isomorphism characterized there on K-injective representatives. Define affineDerivedPushforwardSheafEdge_canonical:f_*H^i→H^i Rf_* to be its inverse natural transformation. The uniqueness theorem determines the chosen isomorphism up to equality, so this defines fixed data without choosing an arbitrary witness of bare existence.

source.place: 0AVW, proof, affine cohomology display; 08D4, bound-one truncation comparison on inverse images of affine opens.

proof.text: Select the unique reverse comparison from its universal property and take its inverse. The uniqueness clause fixes all data used downstream.
